scope: One bounded numerical feasibility study of the explicit electric sheet and inert component readout. No task package, model evaluation, Docker or Git.
decision: Approved for bounded feasibility after independent analytical closure and overlap review.
root_review: Read complete proposal and peer; independently checked sheet jump/force/energy identities, shared calibration monotonicity and mechanical Green-function/source-difference algebra. Rehashed all26 peer evidence files. Existing passers do not already contain this transient repair, but ease risk remains substantial.
specification_requirements: Fix real zero-phase incident spectrum, energy normalization and finite clock explicitly; retain compact profile unless a documented predeclared pulse choice is needed.
Define calibration as positive forward radiation load, equal to magnitude of opposing holding force.
Use fixed unit illuminated area and consistently per-area sheet/mass/spring quantities.
Write and hash a complete numerical plan before execution: fixed domains, clocks, calibration/noise, seeds, study sizes and refinements. Preserve every weak or cancellation case.
domain_qualification: These are initial planning ranges, not a validated grading domain. Author may set the one final study plan before any computation; preserve that plan and all results. Do not select isolated favorable clocks after inspecting gaps.
required_checks: Independent time-domain Maxwell jump/characteristic exterior-stress reference plus Newton mechanics against frequency-domain optical and mechanical oracle. No compact oracle force as reference input.
Separate tail and temporal/spectral refinement; if using finite thickness include interior field momentum and thickness convergence.
Positive oscillator energy, energy balance, impulse, shared stationary calibration and appropriate mechanical limits.
Ordinary nonzero signals, full declared-domain gap survey with weak cases retained, fixed-noise parameter and prediction robustness (256 datasets when feasible), runtime.
Benchmark prediction gate remains0.04; no population pass-rate or model-difficulty claim before evaluation.
stop_rule: Report feasibility or specific failure with preserved outputs; no automatic full package or broader candidate search.
